notes:
Movie and show pages look like Plex's: the backdrop with the title over it, Play or Resume with the time left, play from the start, favorites, mark as watched, the story, cast and crew with photos, and episodes by season with pictures.

Pick the audio language, subtitles and quality on a Plex title's page or while it plays (Audio & subtitles). Lower qualities are converted by your Plex server. Your picks carry on to the next episode.

Your Plex server's dashboard (and Tautulli) now shows what StreamMate is playing.

A movie on now in the guide and the same movie on demand show as one title, offering both ways to watch.

Emby and Jellyfin are marked Coming soon while they get tested; Plex is ready.
